_about: LOOK_LOCK (Vincent, Nov 4 2026): guards the main cast's signature looks so no other NPC resembles them and their own style cannot drift silently; also holds the AGENTS rule 11 palette sets. Read by tests/look_lock.spec.js only (not in MAPDATA). Changing a locked look, or adding an exception, is a visible change for Vincent.
_how: cast[].signature is the recorded look per key, cast[].grid a hash of its drawn frames, cast[].marks trait sets that are theirs alone. rule.pixel_threshold is the share of opaque pixels two looks may have in common. exceptions[] are known clashes on main, each with its follow-up; the spec fails on a new clash and on an exception that no longer clashes.

rule.same_hair: hair style and colour, plus the top colour or the same accessory
rule.same_outfit: garment, top colour, trim and accessory, with a real accessory or a fixed-colour swap
